item.title: Updated 2026 Honda WR-V launched in Indonesia with new 10.25” infotainment and design tweaks
item.description: Honda Indonesia has launched the updated 2026 Honda WR-V, debuting at the Indonesia International Motor Show (IIMS) 2026. The refreshed Honda WR-V gains a new 10.25-inch infotainment touchscreen across all variants, now supporting wireless smartphone connectivity. A USB-C port for the front row is also newly standardised throughout the range. Depending on variant, Honda has also added paddle shifters, a wireless charger, and ambient or mood lighting.
